name: Airfloa Rail Technology Ltd
tagline: A 20-year rolling-stock components + coach-interiors maker mid-inflection: Q1FY27 revenue +200% YoY, FY27 guidance Rs 500 Cr (+66%), and a deliberate pivot from 'railways manufacturer' to precision manufacturer for railways + aerospace & defence - @a_basumallick STOCK STORY feature.
business_overview: Incorporated 1998. Manufactures high-precision forged/machined components and interior/exterior assemblies for rolling stock (Indian Railways, metro, export coaches - Vande Bharat, Namo Bharat, Kolkata Metro) and is scaling critical components for aerospace & defence (mainly HAL; anti-drone / defence work referenced). SMERA SME-1 rating (highest). Seeded as a trusted-X lead: @a_basumallick ran a 'STOCK STORY' feature framing the railways-to-precision-A&D transition as 'a very interesting business' (x_conviction_strength: high).

~Rs 433.8 Cr (Jun-end); bid pipeline ~Rs 1,200 Cr (rail / metro / A&D)

fundamentals_narrative: The live inflection is confirmed by primary filings, but with a real caveat the original trusted-X-sourced write-up didn't carry: FY26 revenue grew 66% (Rs319.6cr) and Q1FY27 grew ~200% YoY (Rs100.7cr), yet FY26 EBITDA margin compressed ~500bps YoY to 20.1%, and Q1FY27 PAT grew only ~69% against that 200% revenue growth. Management guides Rs500cr FY27 revenue (70-75% order-book covered) and a 12-13% PAT margin recovery, but that margin recovery is a forward commitment (quality_stage 'expectation'), not yet evidenced in a reported quarter. Machinery capex is also running behind its own FY26 budget (Rs2.91cr utilized vs Rs13.68cr planned), pushed to FY27 on supply-chain delays. ROE is ~22%. Valuation is ~29x trailing but ~19x FY27E earnings against the guided 56% revenue growth, so there is genuine room to pay if the margin recovery lands. Risks: SME-scale, order-book lumpiness, HAL customer concentration in the A&D leg, unconfirmed post-IPO leverage, and a capex execution slip already on record.
